mine.title: My tasks
mine.description: The tasks you own, in every project you can see.
mine.caption: Tasks you own

team.title: Team tasks
team.description: Every task of the projects you manage, whoever owns it.
team.caption: Tasks of the projects you manage

overdue.title: Overdue tasks
overdue.description: Your tasks and those of the projects you manage whose planned finish has passed, most overdue first.
overdue.caption: Overdue tasks

updates.title: Updates required
updates.description: Your tasks and those of the projects you manage that are waiting for a start or a progress figure.
updates.caption: Tasks that need an update

project.title: Tasks
project.caption: The project's tasks, each with its subtasks

forbidden: You do not have access to tasks.

updates.notStarted: Not started; planned to start on {date}

mine.title: No tasks are assigned to you
mine.body: When a Project Manager makes you the owner of a task, it appears here, whichever project it belongs to.

team.title: The projects you manage have no tasks yet
team.body: Plan tasks in a project's Tasks tab; every task of the projects you manage appears here.
team.noProjectTitle: You do not manage a project
team.noProjectBody: Team tasks lists every task of the projects you manage. Your own tasks are under My tasks.

overdue.title: Nothing is overdue
overdue.body: A task is overdue when its planned finish has passed and it is neither completed nor cancelled. Your tasks and those of the projects you manage are checked.

updates.title: No task needs an update
updates.body: A task needs an update when its planned start has passed and it has not started, or when it has started and has no progress figure, or its figure has not changed for 7 days.

project.title: This project has no tasks yet
project.manager: Add the first task to plan the work against the schedule.
project.waiting: The Project Manager has not planned any task yet.
project.notPlanned: Tasks are planned once the project is approved.
project.noLonger: No tasks were planned for this project, and none are added while it is suspended, completed or closed.

filtered.title: No task matches this choice
filtered.body: Open tasks are those not started, in progress or blocked. Choose "All tasks" to see completed and cancelled tasks too.

owner.userIdHint: You cannot search for people, so enter the user ID the administrator gave you, such as 3c3c3c3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000103.
owner.hint: The owner must hold a role on this project. The server checks this when you save.

form.activityHint: The activity of the project's schedule this task carries out. Its progress feeds the activity's.
form.activitiesUnreadable: The project's schedule cannot be shown to you, so no schedule activity can be chosen here.
form.subtaskActivityHint: A subtask carries out its parent's schedule activity.
form.prioritiesUnreadable: The priority list cannot be shown to you, so no priority can be chosen here.

assign.title: Assign task
assign.intro: Choose who owns {task}. The owner starts the task, reports its progress and completes it.

dependency.title: Add dependency
dependency.intro: Choose two tasks without subtasks, and how the first holds back the second.
dependency.circular: This would create a circular dependency: {chain}. Choose tasks that do not already depend on each other.

dependencyType.FS: Finish to start: the second starts after the first is completed
dependencyType.SS: Start to start: the second starts after the first has started
dependencyType.FF: Finish to finish: the second is completed after the first is completed
dependencyType.SF: Start to finish: the second is completed after the first has started

detail.title: Task
detail.subtasksOpen: It can be completed once its {count} open subtasks are completed.
detail.unblockFirst: A blocked task is unblocked before it can be completed.

progress.hint: From 0 to 100, up to four decimal places.

cancel.body: A cancelled task cannot be started, changed or reopened again.

removeDependency.title: Remove dependency
removeDependency.body: The second task will no longer wait for the first. A dependency is not edited; add it again to change it.

done.stale: Someone changed this task meanwhile, so nothing was saved. The latest version is shown.

fieldErrors.assigneeNotEligible: This person holds no role on this project, so they cannot own its tasks. Choose someone who works on the project.
fieldErrors.userIdMalformed: Enter a user ID in the form 3c3c3c3c-0000-4000-8000-000000000103.
fieldErrors.scheduleActivityInvalid: Choose an activity of this project's schedule that has no sub-activities and is not cancelled.
fieldErrors.priorityInvalid: Choose a priority from the list.
fieldErrors.finishBeforeStart: The planned finish cannot be before the planned start.
fieldErrors.percentMalformed: Enter a number such as 40 or 62.5, with at most four decimal places.
fieldErrors.dependencyBroken: The second task has already taken the step this dependency would hold back, so it cannot be added now.

problems.projectNotEligible: This project is not in a state that allows this: tasks are planned once the project is approved and worked on while it is active.
problems.notEditable: This task is cancelled and cannot be changed.
problems.hierarchyInvalid: A subtask can only be added under an open task that is not itself a subtask and has no dependencies.
problems.scheduleActivityInvalid: The schedule activity is not one this task can carry out.
problems.assigneeNotEligible: The server did not accept this owner: they hold no role on this project. Nothing was changed.
problems.priorityInvalid: The priority is no longer offered. Choose another.
problems.dependencyUnmet: A task it depends on has not reached the point this needs yet. See its dependencies.
problems.subtasksOpen: Its subtasks must be completed first, or its parent is completed.
problems.inUse: It cannot be cancelled while it has open subtasks or dependencies.
problems.progressNotEnterable: Progress can only be entered on a task without subtasks while it is in progress or blocked.
problems.dependencyInvalid: A dependency joins two different tasks without subtasks, of the same project, that are not cancelled.
problems.dependencyCircular: This would create a circular dependency.
problems.dependencyExists: These two tasks are already linked.
problems.invalidTransition: The task is no longer in a state that allows this. A blocked task is unblocked before it is completed.
problems.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to do this to this task.
